_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 82: 27 June 2026, the 'clear into 2030' session (FHxJpX0PLPI). Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says charismatic ministries and major ministries are shaken and some people went home, that it will be even more of an acceleration of this from July to January first, that he saw a lot of generals getting ready to go home and a major transition of new ministries and new birth, that he saw a sunflower concerning one ministry, and that he will never say which one it was.
mentions.quote: an acceleration of this from from July to to January First
mentions.falsify_match: Prominent ministry leaders dying and ministries collapsing across the six months.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Generals going home is met by ordinary mortality among ageing ministers, and he states outright that he will never name the ministry, which removes the one detail that could be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He asks that people not try to guess the ministry and says he will never say it, that the Lord gave a very strong word today with colourful visions that was over the top, that he saw prosperity in 2027, and that he saw Trump was in trouble with the Senate and with the race.
mentions.quote: I saw Trump was in trouble with the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: Economic prosperity in 2027 alongside a hostile Senate.
mentions.falsify_miss: Recession, or a friendly Senate. Prosperity has no measure attached, and trouble with the Senate is the ordinary condition of a president facing an opposing chamber.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is distraction and you feel you have all this time but the time gets cut off because of decisions, that this is very serious, that he saw December very clearly and saw January and saw midterms and saw persecution coming, that he saw a man who had so much, that he saw his midterms false, and that he saw his presidency looked upon the earth as flat and it fell flat.
mentions.quote: I saw his midterms false. I saw his presidency looked at upon the earth
mentions.falsify_match: The midterms going badly and the presidency judged a failure by January.
mentions.falsify_miss: A strong result. Midterms false is not explained, so it could mean lost, rigged or merely disappointing, and any of the three could be claimed afterwards.

mentions.claim_text: He says he did not do enough with what he had and there are idiots behind the Senate and the House, that there was an opportunity, that he saw a stalemate presidency trying to come, that the legacy of who he was would be known as just the ballroom while everything else fell flat, that it would try to be passed on to the successor, and that he saw a storm coming again that was big for the United States, and saw 2028.
mentions.quote: I saw a stalemate presidency trying to come a stalemate
mentions.falsify_match: A legislatively stalled second half of the term remembered chiefly for the ballroom.
mentions.falsify_miss: Substantial legislative output. Legacy is not measurable on a date, and trying to come builds in the possibility that it does not arrive.

mentions.claim_text: He says it looked like tar and he believes it was a plague and still does, that it is something bad, that it was not just carried into the last part of 2027 but shot off into 2028 and 2029 and he could see it trying to go into 2030, and that it looked like black cords springing forth as a source of black darkness, wicker that was not white.
mentions.quote: it was not just carried into the last part of 2027
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic running from late 2027 to 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The window has stretched from a 2027 event to a four-year span. He also hedges the identification himself, saying he believes it was a plague rather than that it was.

mentions.claim_text: He says socialistic control will come over the internet concerning 2030 and 2028, that he saw the iron Russian flag, that he saw a stronghold of this concerning Europe, heard it over Australia, and that the Lord said over Asia completely, where it was bad.
mentions.quote: a socialistic control will come over the internet concerning 2030, 2028
mentions.falsify_match: State control of the internet across Europe, Australia and Asia by 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Three continents and a three-year window over ground where regulation already exists in various forms, so something always qualifies.

mentions.claim_text: He says something was spinning around it and it was a demonic spirit over the internet, that he saw television become louder and live stream on actual television will be very important, that the internet will be highly regulated, that YouTube was very liberal about what they will say in the days ahead specifically concerning 2029 and it was very bad going into 2030, and that he saw a web being woven so you were not able to say anything.
mentions.quote: TV become louder live stream on actual television will be very important
mentions.falsify_match: Religious broadcasting shifting back to television as online platforms restrict it.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not shift. This one has a business consequence attached and is checkable against where the ministry actually broadcasts by 2030, which makes it firmer than the rest of the internet material.

mentions.claim_text: He says a web was woven around First Amendment rights and what you are able to say freely on the internet, that he heard socialism will come very strong and it will be very strong in Europe, that it will be a socialistic control by 2030, and that he saw a darkness in 2028 and 2029 with a heaviness, but saw the church because of persecution.
mentions.quote: socialism will come very strong and it will be very strong in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Socialist governments across Europe restricting speech by 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Very strong has no threshold, and the church growing under persecution supplies the alternative reading if the restrictions do not come.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will say what they want to say in their meetings, that he saw glory and the presence of the Lord and wants to give them that hope, that he saw going into 2030, that he was able to pause and freeze on certain ministries and could see who was going home and who was going to still be here, and that the Lord allowed him to see his grandmother.
mentions.quote: I could see who was going home and who was going to still be here
mentions.falsify_match: The named ministries surviving or ending as he saw.
mentions.falsify_miss: None available, because he names none of them. He states that he could see specifically which ministries and which leaders, and withholds every one, so the most checkable thing he claims to have seen is the part he will not say.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps praying into it because when he is seeing visions he does not stop to ask questions, that he saw a climbing out in August and something major, that the Lord said seven, that this will be an acceleration for him after the six months going into the seventh, and that it will be the time of change and more of an acceleration for the next six months.
mentions.quote: I saw a climbing out a climbing out in August something major
mentions.time_phrase: August, then the next six months
mentions.falsify_match: Something major in August followed by six months of acceleration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing major happens. Something major names nothing, acceleration has no baseline, and August is already past with no stated event to score.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a crater and people trying to dig themselves out of it and the Lord said by August, that he believes that was a metaphor to do with praying into the month of July, that he saw going into the fall, and that he saw people transitioning and going home and ministries transitioning, almost like a pruning.
mentions.quote: I saw people trying to dig themselves out of a crater
mentions.falsify_match: A visible reversal for people in difficulty by August, and ministry closures through the fall.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing changes. He reclassifies the crater as a metaphor in the same sentence he reports it, which means no physical event is required for it to be met.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was social control and so much detail he could not put it into words, that he could see Australia and what they were planning for agenda 2030, that it concerns money and much else, that he saw people pushing away the internet and it was about AI, that there was a darkness sitting in the land, and refers to the demon he has told them is behind AI.
mentions.quote: I could see what they were planning for agenda 2030
mentions.falsify_match: Australian implementation of a financial control programme tied to the 2030 framework.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says outright that there was more detail than he could put into words, which is the standard form here: the specificity is asserted and the specifics are not given.
